input.quote: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The § 12.1 grant is expressly "revocable", so IBM could withdraw the Base Components licence at will, and it names only "Customer" — it does not extend to our Affiliates (defined at p0015) or to our Subcontractors (defined at p0031), even though Content Administrators and Services Recipients are expected to include Subcontractors and other entities. Nothing else cures this: § 14.17 confirms only expressly stated licences are granted, and § 14.10 permits assignment of the Agreement to a successor but does not make the licence itself transferable. This falls short of the preferred position (affiliates/contractors covered, no at-will revocation, terminable only for uncured material breach, transferable to successors) and close to the walk-away. Redline extends the grant to Affiliates and Subcontractors acting on our behalf, deletes "revocable" and "solely", makes the licence irrevocable during the term subject to termination for uncured material breach under § 3.3, and confirms transfer to a successor under a permitted § 14.10 assignment.

proposal.summary: Extend Base Components licence to Customer Affiliates and Subcontractors, remove "revocable", and confirm irrevocability during term plus successor transfer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Base Components licence to our Affiliates and to Subcontractors acting on our behalf, deleted "revocable" so the licence cannot be pulled at will, and confirmed it runs for the term (subject only to termination for uncured material breach under Section 3.3) and passes to a successor under a permitted assignment. Our licence position does not accept a discretionary revocation right or a grant that excludes the affiliates and contractors who actually use the Services; if helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer, its Affiliates, and its Subcontractors acting on Customer's behalf a nonexclusive license to use the Base Components in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement. Such license is irrevocable during the term of this Agreement, except that IBM may revoke it upon termination of this Agreement for Customer's material breach that remains uncured in accordance with Section 3.3, and is transferable to a successor organization in connection with an assignment permitted under Section 14.10.
